reference.title: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference — VPORT
reference.finding: The VPORT symbol table record group 333 is an optional soft-pointer to the shade-plot object.

problem: The low-level VPORT writer refused every nonzero shade-plot target and used remap-only logic for group 333 even though VIEWPORT and PLOTSETTINGS already support resolver-first reference translation.
change: The direct VPORT writer emits group 333 using the configured final-ID resolver, or the source handle remap when no resolver is configured. A nonzero source must resolve to a nonzero, non-sentinel output; explicit null presence and existing target-version/mode gates remain intact. The concrete adapter still refuses a nonzero shade target until target-kind, owner and graph closure are qualified.

validation.result: PASS both focused selectors, including zero-remap refusal and corrected same-codec retry
coverage: ASCII/Binary direct group-333 resolver precedence and remap fallback
unresolved nonzero target resolving to zero leaves destination intact
same-codec corrected retry and typed readback
adapter continues refusing a nonzero target without graph closure
explicit null and absent group distinction; mode and version boundaries
zero remap refusal preserves destination and corrected mapping retries on same codec

limits: This is direct writer reference transport; the test does not prove target emission, target kind or ownership, physical producer breadth, native rendering, or support claim eligibility.
No DWG or DXF fixture added.
